Maria S.: Quick async check — I hit a broken in-page anchor in the deploy runbook while updating the kv-cache snippet. Anchor URL: https://kb.internal/docs/deploy/kv-cache#troubleshooting returns page but fragment 404 in preview. Can someone grab this? small PR I can open if no objections.
link-scanner-bot: Automated scan: found 'kv-cache' runbook: fragment mismatch — header changed from 'Troubleshooting' to 'Troubleshooting & FAQ' (anchor id now troubleshooti-ng-and-faq). Suggest either update fragment or add an explicit id.
Jon P.: I can grab it if it's just a frontmatter/header tweak.
Sam K.: Does this break any runtime links or product-facing docs, or just internal runbook previews?
Maria S.: Just internal runbook previews and a bunch of devs hitting it via onboarding script. Not product-critical, but annoying for new devs.
Priya R.: FYI codeowners for that folder are @eng-docs and @onboarding-squad — might need a quick owners-approval.
Maria S.: Minimal patch plan: change H2 to include explicit id so legacy links keep working. e.g.,
```md
## Troubleshooting {#troubleshooting}
```
Would that be okay?
Jon P.: yep, that sed one-liner should do it.
Maria S.: sed suggestion I ran locally: `perl -0777 -pe "s/## Troubleshooting(?!\s*\{)/## Troubleshooting {#troubleshooting}/s" -i docs/deploy/kv-cache.md` — opens a tiny PR.
Sam K.: quick CR offer: I can review once PR is up, ping me with link.
Jon P.: also check for any links in /onboarding that reference the old fragment; can ripgrep to be safe: `rg "kv-cache#troubleshooting" -n`
Maria S.: good call, will run that and attach results to PR description.
Priya R.: tagging owners in the PR will speed merge: `@eng-docs please review (tiny frag id add)`.
Maria S.: Opening PR in ~10m and will include the rg output. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Jon P.: thanks Maria — if you want faster merge I can approve once Sam gives CR.
Maria S.: leaving with Jon to shepherd, adding small note to the runbook changelog. Thanks everyone :rocket:
